_comment: Hand-maintained sealed product definitions. packsContained and msrpCents are physical/published facts. marketCents is a hand-tracked CURRENT market (street) price with provenance and an as-of date — a labelled stopgap that a sealed-capable price source (PriceCharting) automatically supersedes; the data layer prefers live source prices whenever they exist. promos lists guaranteed non-pack cards by pokemontcg.io id; they are ingested from the svp promo set, priced live, and added to EV as fixed extras. Sets released before Sword & Shield (2020-02-07) deliberately carry msrpCents: null — their original retail price is real history but no longer purchasable, so showing a retail ROI against it would imply a price nobody can actually pay. Market price is the only honest denominator for those.

products.name: Team Rocket's Moltres ex Ultra-Premium Collection (18 packs)
products.contentsNote: Packs are a fixed multi-set mix. Published breakdowns attribute 17 of the 18 packs — 2 Destined Rivals, 2 Journey Together, 2 Temporal Forces, 2 Paradox Rift, 3 Obsidian Flames, 3 Paldea Evolved, 3 Scarlet & Violet — and EV blends each set's own odds; the 18th pack isn't attributed to a set, so it's omitted. Also includes 3 Destined Rivals-stamped Team Rocket's Moltres ex promos (regular, full-art, special illustration rare), a playmat, deck box, coin, dice and markers — not modelled, so EV understates the product.

products.name: Ultra-Premium Collection — Charizard (16 packs)
products.contentsNote: The publisher's own listing states “16 Pokémon TCG booster packs from the Sword & Shield Series” without naming sets — the assortment varies box to box.
